tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Gove...

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completion of one similar nature of contract of Providing Cars on hire basis of value not less than Rs.10,08,000/- in each case, in Government / Semi Government / Private organizations in last three years i.e (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26)
The Tenderer should have annual financial turnover of Rs.20,16,000/- at least in two financial years in providing cars on hire basis in last three years i.e (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26)
